targets.queryText: SELECT r.id AS "Run ID", r.started_at AS Started, LOWER(REPLACE(m.mode, '_', '')) AS Mode, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_version, ''), 'unknown') AS Version, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_commit, ''), 'unknown') AS "Commit", COALESCE(r.analytics_client_id, 'unknown') AS "Anonymous player", r.status AS Status, r.final_placement AS Placement, r.final_health AS "Final health", r.final_round AS "Final round", r.abandoned_at AS "Abandoned at", r.placement_finalized_at AS "Placement finalized", SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'WIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wins, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'LOSS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Losses, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'DRAW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Draws FROM analytics_player_run r JOIN analytics_match m ON m.id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN analytics_player_round pr ON pr.run_id = r.id WHERE r.id = ${run_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY r.id
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.id AS "Run ID", r.started_at AS Started, LOWER(REPLACE(m.mode, '_', '')) AS Mode, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_version, ''), 'unknown') AS Version, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_commit, ''), 'unknown') AS "Commit", COALESCE(r.analytics_client_id, 'unknown') AS "Anonymous player", r.status AS Status, r.final_placement AS Placement, r.final_health AS "Final health", r.final_round AS "Final round", r.abandoned_at AS "Abandoned at", r.placement_finalized_at AS "Placement finalized", SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'WIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wins, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'LOSS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Losses, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'DRAW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Draws FROM analytics_player_run r JOIN analytics_match m ON m.id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN analytics_player_round pr ON pr.run_id = r.id WHERE r.id = ${run_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY r.id

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER) + 1 AS Slot, json_extract(unit.value, '$.definitionId') AS Unit, json_extract(unit.value, '$.lineId') AS "Line ID", json_extract(unit.value, '$.starLevel') AS Stars, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(item.value, ', ') FROM json_each(json_extract(unit.value, '$.itemIds')) AS item), '—') AS Items FROM analytics_player_run r JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(r.final_board_json) THEN r.final_board_json ELSE '[]' END) AS unit WHERE r.id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER) + 1 AS Slot, json_extract(unit.value, '$.definitionId') AS Unit, json_extract(unit.value, '$.lineId') AS "Line ID", json_extract(unit.value, '$.starLevel') AS Stars, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(item.value, ', ') FROM json_each(json_extract(unit.value, '$.itemIds')) AS item), '—') AS Items FROM analytics_player_run r JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(r.final_board_json) THEN r.final_board_json ELSE '[]' END) AS unit WHERE r.id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER)

targets.queryText: SELECT round_number AS Round, COALESCE(opponent_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS Opponent, COALESCE(outcome, 'UNRESOLVED') AS Outcome, pre_health AS "Health before", post_health AS "Health after", gold AS Gold, player_level AS Level, xp AS XP, captured_at AS Captured, resolved_at AS Resolved FROM analytics_player_round WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY round_number
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT round_number AS Round, COALESCE(opponent_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS Opponent, COALESCE(outcome, 'UNRESOLVED') AS Outcome, pre_health AS "Health before", post_health AS "Health after", gold AS Gold, player_level AS Level, xp AS XP, captured_at AS Captured, resolved_at AS Resolved FROM analytics_player_round WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY round_number

targets.queryText: SELECT pr.round_number AS Round, CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER) + 1 AS Slot, json_extract(unit.value, '$.definitionId') AS Unit, json_extract(unit.value, '$.lineId') AS "Line ID", json_extract(unit.value, '$.starLevel') AS Stars, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(item.value, ', ') FROM json_each(json_extract(unit.value, '$.itemIds')) AS item), '—') AS Items FROM analytics_player_round pr JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(pr.board_json) THEN pr.board_json ELSE '[]' END) AS unit WHERE pr.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY pr.round_number, CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT pr.round_number AS Round, CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER) + 1 AS Slot, json_extract(unit.value, '$.definitionId') AS Unit, json_extract(unit.value, '$.lineId') AS "Line ID", json_extract(unit.value, '$.starLevel') AS Stars, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(item.value, ', ') FROM json_each(json_extract(unit.value, '$.itemIds')) AS item), '—') AS Items FROM analytics_player_round pr JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(pr.board_json) THEN pr.board_json ELSE '[]' END) AS unit WHERE pr.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY pr.round_number, CAST(unit.key AS INTEGER)

targets.queryText: SELECT pr.round_number AS Round, json_extract(augment.value, '$.id') AS Augment, json_extract(augment.value, '$.tier') AS Tier FROM analytics_player_round pr JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(pr.augments_json) THEN pr.augments_json ELSE '[]' END) AS augment WHERE pr.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY pr.round_number, CAST(augment.key AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT pr.round_number AS Round, json_extract(augment.value, '$.id') AS Augment, json_extract(augment.value, '$.tier') AS Tier FROM analytics_player_round pr JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(pr.augments_json) THEN pr.augments_json ELSE '[]' END) AS augment WHERE pr.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY pr.round_number, CAST(augment.key AS INTEGER)

targets.queryText: SELECT round_number AS Round, unit_name AS Unit, definition_id AS Definition, star_level AS Stars, damage_dealt AS "Damage dealt", damage_taken AS "Damage taken", healing_done AS Healing, shielding_done AS Shielding FROM analytics_unit_combat_stat WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY round_number, damage_dealt DESC, unit_name
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT round_number AS Round, unit_name AS Unit, definition_id AS Definition, star_level AS Stars, damage_dealt AS "Damage dealt", damage_taken AS "Damage taken", healing_done AS Healing, shielding_done AS Shielding FROM analytics_unit_combat_stat WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY round_number, damage_dealt DESC, unit_name

targets.queryText: SELECT unit_name AS Unit, SUM(damage_dealt) AS "Damage dealt", SUM(damage_taken) AS "Damage taken", SUM(healing_done) AS Healing, SUM(shielding_done) AS Shielding FROM analytics_unit_combat_stat WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY definition_id, unit_name ORDER BY SUM(damage_dealt) DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT unit_name AS Unit, SUM(damage_dealt) AS "Damage dealt", SUM(damage_taken) AS "Damage taken", SUM(healing_done) AS Healing, SUM(shielding_done) AS Shielding FROM analytics_unit_combat_stat WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY definition_id, unit_name ORDER BY SUM(damage_dealt) DESC
